info.name: AUX Transaction Preflight
info.description: Discover and safely evaluate AUX, an evidence-backed transaction-preflight service for autonomous agents. Use synthetic test data only.

request.description: Resolve the standards-based RFC 9727 API catalog.
Read the problems, vocabulary, operations, outputs, and limitations.
Inspect signing, public keys, verification, data handling, and boundaries.
Retrieve synthetic example requests for safe evaluation.
Submit a safe duplicate-invoice scenario. Expected decision: STOP.
Check current availability and signing status.
